prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: complete standalone 1536 x 1024 landscape background plate for a 2.5D action game. Generate BRAND NEW independent environment artwork, not an edit, recolor, crop, rearrangement, or overlay of the reference. The input image is ONLY a reference for bright hand-painted children's fantasy style, warm cream ivory / pale honey stone palette, natural soft edges, overhead 3/4 near-isometric camera, and small irregular paving-stone scale. Match those aspects, invent the entire composition anew. Setting: colorful insect civilization of amber resin, translucent shells, fresh huge leaves, pollen flowers, rounded honeywax architecture. It is a sunny open valley, friendly, rich, luminous, no gloom.
CRITICAL game geometry: image coordinates use normalized x/y. The central playable hard dry floor must remain a single flat continuous clear dry stone surface throughout the polygon [(0.25,0.18),(0.45,0.105),(0.67,0.12),(0.82,0.19),(0.885,0.30),(0.90,0.60),(0.86,0.76),(0.71,0.87),(0.50,0.93),(0.30,0.87),(0.165,0.74),(0.12,0.56),(0.14,0.36),(0.205,0.24)]. Clear ground should dominate about 75% of the image. Broad open dry pathways reach left/right frame edges near mid-height. No central lake, well opening, pit, canal, island gap, tree, wall, tower, roof, chair, stall, basket or flowerbed inside the playable polygon. No drawn objective, chest, enemy, person, creature, egg monster, HUD, UI, map icon, text, letter or watermark anywhere. Tiny flat moss seams and subtle color variations in paving are allowed. Every stone visually small; warm cream ground, not saturated yellow.
All outer scenery naturally supports the floor with roots and softly layered sloping banks. No rectangular floating slab, giant wall or rigid symmetric frame. Complete filled background right to every image edge, with distinctive outer ecological and architectural scene. The seven rooms must look visibly different because each scene has a different entire outer composition and environmental use.
ROOM ID: L09.
Scene/backdrop: Compose a lush insect coming-of-age and nursery garden courtyard. At the northmost corners beyond polygon place two rounded pastel honeywax nursery cottages partly shaded by giant curled fresh leaves, one pale ivory closed empty chrysalis-shaped arcade at far right. Delicate transparent old insect shell pieces are architectural ornaments along extreme northwest edge, NOT living insects. Lower-left and lower-right outer corner flower gardens hold distinct curving bands of lilac pollen bells, empty leaf cradle decorations and airy cocoon garlands. Main composition is garden pockets surrounding a wide open luminous stone clearing, completely new layout with no creek, no boats, no large wing canopy, no central barriers or maze. Far top mid shows flowering valley rather than an imposing wall. Central floor subtle pale blush seams, still same warm cream small-stone material.
Output: one complete 1536 x 1024 landscape image, no text.
